summary.zh: 梳理假设、规划发现冲刺，检验问题方案匹配
summary.en: Map assumptions and test problem-solution fit early

description.zh: 验证一个想法是否值得做：梳理关键假设、安排发现冲刺、检验问题与方案的匹配度。适合在投入开发前判断方向，或想法很多需要先排优先级时使用。
description.en: Validates a product idea by mapping assumptions, planning discovery sprints and testing problem-solution fit. Use it before committing to build, or when several ideas need narrowing down first.
